title: IVG Original Salts Strawberry Sensation 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Strawberry Sensation 10ml E-Liquid is designed for vapers who appreciate the simple, unmistakable taste of perfectly ripened strawberries. This profile focuses on the sweet, vibrant, and slightly jammy notes of fresh Strawberries, providing a clear and authentic fruit experience. The inclusion of a light, smooth cooling sensation on the finish adds a clean edge, making the flavour profile feel exceptionally crisp and refreshing without distracting from the berry base. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the clean fruit notes of Strawberry Sensation, vapers can explore other stellar options like the balanced Strawberry Watermelon or the decadent Vanilla Biscuit. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
